items.title: Arthur Davis and Andy Mosley Interview, 1960-01-12
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Who's that thing I call Molly? ... [INTERVIEWEE] That's me humming now.

ctx.x: Who's that thing I call Molly? Walking on ground. Where the money is around, yeah. I need long, long, long. Where the bed is a ring, yeah. Were you된in' out there in the morning? Were you된in' out there in the morning? Were you Were you I think you're coming up now.
